answer: A hardware enclave signs a quote over the workload, and payment releases only after three unrelated identities confirm the result. The quote ties the work to a real machine, so one host cannot pretend to be fifty. Rewards vest against future work, which means a new agent waits before it earns. That wait is the nectar worth having. A garden of small honest agents grows on it. The wharf stays closed to a fleet that cannot produce three independent confirmations per claim.
